bibl.title: Characterising Discipleship in the Fifth Manichaean Psalm of Heracleides: Women's Participation in Late Antique Egypt.

Garrick Vernon Allen, Kelsie Gayle Rodenbiker, Anthony Philip Royle, Jill Unkel & Usama Ali Mohamed Gad (edd.), The Chester Beatty Biblical Papyri at Ninety. Literature, Papyrology, Ethics = Manuscripta Biblica. 10 (Berlin - New York, 2023) pp. 175-191, figg.
